added: packages/brownfield (@sos-2/brownfield): the W15 Brownfield Optimization Loop orchestrator — a pure, deterministic, typed stage-record pipeline over an existing-system snapshot consuming the MERGED SOS planes and inventing no core identifiers: (1) INGESTION — a BrownfieldSnapshot (source tree descriptor + dependency graph + structural runtime observations + OTel-shaped telemetry traces, golden fixtures) normalized into the spine ImplementationModel contract (deterministic content-addressed id, canonically sorted sections, order-independent), the declared 'as-documented' ArchitectureGraph and the anchor-pattern SystemState binding the exact implementation revision, runtime telemetry ingested through the W12 TelemetryIngestionAdapter with declared-but-unobserved components recorded as explicit UNAVAILABLE gaps (never silence, never zero), runtime conformance evidence over the declared executable invariants at the exact SystemState revision (@sos-2/runtime-conformance + structuralRuntimeAdapter + @sos-2/conformance invariant DSL), and one ingestion Evidence record binding exact revisions + the input digest; (2) COMPETING RECOVERY — @sos-2/recovery hypotheses with the machine-enforced guard assertCompetingHypotheses (ambiguous evidence yielding fewer than two retained hypotheses REJECTS the pipeline — spec/architecture.md section 6 'Code-to-architecture recovery may produce multiple competing hypotheses'), the full competing set retained, one hypothesis deterministically selected; (3) PACKAGE RETRIEVAL — context-conditioned query over the injected @sos-2/registry through the @sos-2/retrieval facade with uncertainty VERBATIM per candidate (surfaced, never stripped) and retrieval evidence OBSERVES the selected hypothesis; (4) CANDIDATE EVOLUTION — the @sos-2/search ladder engine (GREEDY policy, mission-shaped hard constraints, caller-declared predicted estimates) + @sos-2/optimization non-dominated Pareto sorting (the front — never a single winner) and a MAP-Elites quality-diversity repertoire (per-cell elites, families never evicted), then a bounded REPLACE_COMPONENT LocalCandidate over the selected hypothesis whose APPLIED graph must preserve every declared executable invariant (checkInvariants; invariant-violating candidates rejected in canonical order), minted as a new candidate ArchitectureGraph artifact and adapted into a CandidateState fixture through the W9 bridge candidateStateFromLocalCandidate with a deterministically minted CausalHypothesis ref; (5) ASSURANCE — an @sos-2/assurance case over the candidate with a @sos-2/verification runtime monitor (invariant preservation over monitor events) and PASS-verdict runtime-conformance evidence in the pool, one RETAINED RESOLVED objection, truthful evaluateAssuranceCase (revision bounds + freshness + assumption checks), the W8->W9 verdict projection (VALID->SATISFIED, OBJECTIONED->INCOMPLETE, INVALID->REFUTED) and blocks=true on INVALID (an assurance-invalid candidate can never be promoted); (6) EXPERIMENT — a TREATMENT_CONTROL experiment advanced SHADOW->CANARY->CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT and simulated with the @sos-2/experiments fixed-seed simulator, the simulated marker MACHINE-CHECKED (assertSimulatedOutcome — a brownfield outcome without simulated=true REJECTS) and NEVER presented as intervention evidence (the promotion gate is fed an EMPTY evidence list — presenting the simulated record is REJECTED, pinned by negative tests); (7) PROMOTION/ROLLBACK — @sos-2/promotion evaluatePromotion with a minted @sos-2/authority grant (KIND CandidateState scope, PROMOTE permission, TIME-bound; confidence never authorization), live guardrail triggers wired in (a triggered ROLLBACK trigger drives decision ROLLBACK before every other gate), and a recovery-control-shaped BoundedRecoveryDeclaration always built and validated; a ROLLBACK decision without a recovery declaration REJECTS the pipeline (assertRollbackRecovery); the honest nominal-path decision is EXPERIMENT (no real intervention evidence exists in a deterministic simulation — promotion stays evidence-gated); (8) RECONCILIATION — implementation-vs-declared drift classification through @sos-2/conformance reconcile over the selected hypothesis' model_view (interface projection included), zero-filled counts over all 7 frozen classes, DRIFT/CONTRADICTION findings retained as Evidence-shaped drift records; (9) PACKAGE LEARNING — outcomes feed the ecology: @sos-2/transfer transfer evidence (source context from the package's OWN registry-declared context, target = the brownfield system context, claim strength CORRELATIONAL, never updating the source package's applicability estimate), @sos-2/ecology decay signals into the read-only MaturityReviewQueue (evidence-shaped input only — never auto-demotion), and @sos-2/memory ArchitectureMemory with retained PREDICTION/OBSERVATION/OUTCOME (realized UNKNOWN — honest under simulated-only evidence) plus FAILURE and ROLLBACK entries and a LEARNED_RULE on the rollback variant; TRACEABILITY INVARIANT — every stage handoff is a typed spine trace link (collected through TraceLinkStore, duplicate links rejected), and assertBrownfieldTraceChain verifies the full loop is ONE connected semantic subgraph rooted at the ImplementationModel reaching every learned ecology update (memory artifact, transfer source package, decay-signal packages) — a missing link FAILS the pipeline; the trace graph is queryable (queryBrownfieldTrace, directed upstream/downstream) and the whole result is canonical-serializable and byte-identical on re-run (canonicalBrownfieldText), with the golden scenario exported as pure JSON (GOLDEN_BROWNFIELD_SCENARIO: the fake 'merch-catalog-legacy' legacy system — deliberately ambiguous (service kinds + grouped shard realizations) so recovery produces competing hypotheses, and deliberately drifted (a declared-but-removed reporting component, an undeclared cache module) so reconciliation classifies real differences)

apps/brownfield-harness (@sos-2/brownfield-harness): the runnable end-to-end W15 harness over the golden brownfield scenario — ZERO domain logic (imports the @sos-2/brownfield orchestrator and the golden scenario only): builds the loop input deterministically (fresh registry + learning stores per run), executes BOTH golden variants (nominal world -> healthy simulated experiment -> honest EXPERIMENT decision; degraded world -> guardrail breach -> ROLLBACK decision + bounded recovery declaration + failure/rollback memory), prints the deterministic one-screen summary (ingested -> hypotheses (N) -> retrieved -> candidate -> assurance verdict -> experiment outcome -> decision -> drift classes -> learned updates -> trace chain), verifies the full trace chain of both variants, and exits 0 ONLY if both chains are complete; the committed golden-run fixture pins byte-identical output (deterministic snapshot test includes the trace graph) and the vitest suite re-runs the harness twice asserting identical output; no network, no time dependence (single caller-supplied instant, fixed seed)

packages/brownfield/W15.architecture-delta.json: this Architecture Delta record — DECLARED HERE because spec/** is outside W15's owned paths; the Architect may reconcile it into spec/contracts/deltas/ at merge time
preserved_invariants: the Semantic Spine remains the ONLY identity/envelope/trace authority: @sos-2/brownfield imports every minter, envelope, trace link, canonical serializer and the ImplementationModel contract from @sos-2/semantic-spine and mints the CausalHypothesis/SystemState-anchor/Evaluation-subject ids only through the exported deterministic minters; no second identity system, no invented core identifiers, no new artifact kinds registered

the 17 frozen trace link types, 6 truth states, 7 conformance classes, 19 core artifact kinds, the 9 node/8 edge kind vocabularies, the 10 evolution operators, the 6 decision actions, the §10 altitude ladder, the 9 diversity dimensions and the package maturity lifecycle are all imported from their merged authorities and NEVER redefined or extended

ambiguous evidence produces RETAINED competing hypotheses (never one): enforced by the assertCompetingHypotheses pipeline guard, pinned by negative tests, and the full hypothesis set is retained in the loop result even after deterministic selection

simulated outcomes are marked and NEVER intervention evidence: the experiment stage machine-checks the simulated marker, the promotion stage presents an EMPTY evidence list (the honest nominal decision is EXPERIMENT — promotion stays evidence-gated), and presenting the simulated record as evidence is REJECTED by the promotion gate (pinned by negative tests)

an assurance-invalid candidate is never promoted: the W8 verdict projects INVALID->REFUTED and the promotion gate REJECTS (pinned by negative tests); objections are retained (the golden case carries a RESOLVED objection — terminal, never dropped)

a ROLLBACK decision always carries a bounded recovery declaration (recovery-control shape: mechanism + max_recovery_seconds + triggers wired to the experiment guardrail records + authority ref); rollback without recovery declaration REJECTS the pipeline (pinned by negative tests)

the full loop is ONE connected trace-linked semantic subgraph from ImplementationModel to the learned ecology updates; every stage handoff is a typed spine trace link; duplicate links and missing links fail the pipeline loudly (assertBrownfieldTraceChain + TraceLinkStore; pinned by negative tests); the trace graph is queryable in both directions

candidate evolution is bounded and invariant-preserving: the LocalCandidate bounds are the target component's incident subgraph, the APPLIED graph must pass every declared executable invariant (violating candidates rejected in canonical order), and uncertainty is carried end-to-end into the Pareto/repertoire evaluation (an uncertainty-stripped candidate is rejected by @sos-2/optimization)

no silent autonomy: the loop never activates, promotes or self-approves anything — the nominal decision is EXPERIMENT (evidence-gated), rollback is safety-first, the decay signals feed a READ-ONLY maturity review queue (never auto-demotion), and transfer evidence never updates the source package's applicability estimate

determinism discipline: single caller-supplied instant (no hidden clocks), fixed seed, content-addressed ids, canonical serialization with sorted input normalization (order-independent digests), fresh injected stores per run, and the golden-run fixture pins byte-identical outputs; the full test suite produces identical results on repeated runs

no frozen contract in spec/ or spec/contracts/ was modified and no schema was touched; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths (including W14's packages/greenfield + apps/greenfield-harness) are untouched; all W15 changes are additive under the two owned paths
